propositions: event_append.py exceeds 740 LOC post-rebase and requires splitting to stay under the 800-LOC hard gate

Four independent concerns (pre-lock event prep, git verb composition, commit-failure self-heal, locked write orchestration) exist in event_append and must be split into separate modules while preserving all external bindings
All five moved code regions must remain byte-identical and all relocated symbols must be re-exported from event_append so no consumer, monkeypatch target, or import path changes

event_prepare.py and event_commit_git.py must be leaf modules (neither importing event_append nor each other) with event_append retaining the commit-failure self-heal to preserve the single-setattr monkeypatch seam
Every external binding including alias-only references (e.g. _ea.canonical_bytes from conftest.py) must resolve through getattr on the imported event_append module with zero test file edits
